attackers_goals: Attackers may attempt to gain persistence on the endpoint using scheduled tasks.
description: A scheduled task was created via file access from an unsigned process. This is uncommon and may indicate malicious activity.
investigative_actions: Review the process executed by the schedule task. Investigate the specific scheduled task execution chain.
